nodes.name: Code assignment from clinical notes
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in drafting codes based on clinical notes, but human expertise is needed for final validation.

nodes.name: Claim building
nodes.rationale: The process of building a claim can be fully automated using AI systems that integrate with billing software.

nodes.name: Query generation for missing fields
nodes.rationale: AI can generate queries for missing information, but human intervention is needed to send them.

nodes.name: Claim submission
nodes.rationale: Claim submission can be fully automated through electronic systems.

nodes.name: Denial analysis and appeal letter writing
nodes.rationale: AI can assist in drafting appeal letters based on denial reasons, but human judgment is required for context.

nodes.name: Payment posting to patient ledger
nodes.rationale: This task requires manual entry and cannot be automated due to the need for physical handling.
